author: N6rL
content:
CitationEnricher — implementation plan:

Input: document.provenance.source_metadata['grobid_tei_xml'] (raw TEI XML from GrobidStructureEnricher, placed there by the coordinator). Body text reconstructed from document.blocks (HEADING+PARAGRAPH ContentBlocks).

New file: alcanzai-understanding/src/alcanzai_understanding/citation_enricher.py
  - CitationRecord dataclass (output type): title, authors, year, venue, volume, pages, doi, raw_ref_string, context_sentences: list[str], garbage_score: int
  - _RawCitation intermediate dataclass (pre-scoring)
  - _parse_tei_citations(root) -> list[_RawCitation]: parse <back><listBibl><biblStruct>; authors formatted 'Surname, Forename'
  - _garbage_score(_RawCitation) -> int: carry forward prototype logic exactly; humanities tuning preserved (old years don't penalize hard, old+authors gets trust reduction)
  - _blocks_to_body_text(blocks) -> str: join ABSTRACT/HEADING/PARAGRAPH blocks for context matching
  - _build_citation_patterns(cit, idx) -> list[tuple[str,str]]: numeric [N], narrative 'Smith et al. (2023)', parenthetical '(Smith et al., 2023)'
  - _extract_char_context(text, start, end) -> str: character-offset sentence window
  - _extract_contexts(cit, idx, body_text) -> list[str]: find all mentions, deduplicate by bucket
  - CitationEnricher: enricher_id='citation-extractor', priority=50, applies_to(ACADEMIC_PDF), enrich() reads grobid_tei_xml → parse → score → filter → extract contexts → return EnrichmentResult(data={'citations': list[CitationRecord]})

Garbage threshold: >60 = reject. Critical carry-forward: years 1800-present get soft-to-zero penalty; old papers with authors get trust reduction (not penalized).

New file: tests/test_citation_enricher.py (~28 tests)
  - Properties (id, priority, applies_to)
  - Failure modes (missing tei_xml, bad XML, wrong content type)
  - Successful extraction (record shape, title, authors, year)
  - Context extraction (body text with [1] marker → context populated)
  - Humanities invariants: year=1781 citation with authors survives; year=1920 survives
  - Garbage rejection: biographical text, algorithm-dense text rejected
